summary: A 1948 L-4 cab moved from Teapot Dome; the two-story cab that stands today is dated 1983 or 1986, staffed in fire season, hike-in.

facts.design: Two-story cab on the 1948 L-4 site. NHLR says wood frame; Firelookout.com says log hip-roofed; Idaho Fire Lookouts says R-4 log cab

visit.trail_note: Listed as hike-in on Idaho Fire Lookouts. No public climbing rule found in the sources.

corrections.proposed: Two-story R-4 log cab (dated 1983 or 1986) on the site of a 1948 L-4 cabin
corrections.why: The L-4 cab was replaced by a flat R-6 cab in 1974 and then by the two-story cab, so L-4 describes only the 1948 cab.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and Firelookout.com give 1986 for the two-story cab; Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 1983. The record keeps 1986 because two sources agree, and the 1983 date is noted.
NHLR says wood frame, Firelookout.com says log hip-roofed, Idaho Fire Lookouts says R-4 log. Material is reported as disputed.

notes_for_editor: Access level left unset: no source states whether visitors may climb. Staffing as_of is the access date because the sources give no date for their staffing statements. Idaho Fire Lookouts' staff list names individuals; the story does not name them. No notable fire was found in the pages read; the Idaho Fire Lookouts comments mention a big fire on the South Fork; the story cites that reader comment as unnamed and not tied to the tower. A search snippet from idaholookouts.weebly.com (Kresek) also gives 1974 R-6 and 1986 two-story log R-4, but that page was not read past its index, so it is not cited. Height is not in any source read.
